inputs.view: Dual-form illustration: oblique humanoid and oblique delta glider; hidden belly, rear and depths inferred. Anatomical weapon sides follow the prompt.

components.intent: Angular silver widow peak and red sensor, high black collar; shared head folds into the glider nose
Tall navy segmented chest, narrow waist, exposed rigid joints and Serbian red-white-blue bands
Two rigid triangular panels rotate at shoulder hinges from ankle-length cape to one level delta wing; no scale change or new flight parts
Sealed armored core with four exposed limbs aligned close to the body in flight
Anatomical right six-barrel rotary gun and anatomical left twin missile box remain mounted in both forms
Compact flush transducers mounted on the physical shield or melee implement, otherwise on the free elbow or both held weapons; wing and limb sweeps remain clear

decisions: The paired rigid panels keep their size across forms; deploying by rotation prevents material or part replacement at the rig swap.
